_purpose: Inspectable design document for the CNQ → direct vector PDF pipeline with hash-coded fraud prevention. This is the specification, not the implementation. Implementation is queued for post-conference (2026-06-06+) per Phase 5 discipline.
_source: Grok round 6 session 2026-05-12 — distilled across six iterations (v2.0 → v2.5) of progressive refinement

vision.title: CNQ Direct Vector PDF with Hash-Coded Fraud Prevention
vision.description: CNQ should generate publication-quality vector PDFs directly from analysis JSON. Every PDF must be cryptographically bound to its source analysis via embedded hashes for fraud prevention and reproducibility.

pdf_generation_standards.archival_format: PDF/A-3B (allows embedded files; JSON original can be attached to the PDF)
pdf_generation_standards.page_size: A4 landscape (11.69 x 8.27 inches) preferred for plots; A4 portrait acceptable for tables
libraries: pypdf for metadata embedding and file attachment
pdf_generation_standards.fonts: DejaVu Sans or Liberation Sans (must be fully embedded for PDF/A compliance)

required_fields./Hs_Content_SHA256: string (64 hex chars) — CNT JSON hash
required_fields./Hs_CNQ_Content_SHA256: string (64 hex chars) — CNQ JSON hash
required_fields./Hs_Provenance_JSON: minified JSON string containing full provenance summary

optional_fields./Hs_CCTT_Run_ID: unique run identifier from CCTT protocol

metadata_standards.attached_files_pdf_a3: Embed the source CNT JSON and CNQ JSON as PDF/A-3 attached files using pypdf's file attachment API

verification_methods.attached_file_extraction: pypdf supports listing and extracting embedded files in PDF/A-3
verification_methods.hash_reverification: Re-run CNT/CNQ on the source data (re-extracted or supplied separately) and compare SHA-256 against the embedded values

missing_critical_keys.content_sha256: Raise ValueError with message 'Missing content_sha256 in CNQ JSON'. Critical — cannot produce fraud-resistant PDF without this.
missing_critical_keys.cnq_content_sha256: Raise ValueError with message 'Missing cnq_content_sha256 in CNQ JSON'. Critical.

missing_visualization_keys.bearing: Use empty array. Skip the bearing plot page with a placeholder text. Log warning to JOURNAL.md.
missing_visualization_keys.helmsman: Use empty array. Skip the helmsman plot page with a placeholder text. Log warning.
missing_visualization_keys.k_eff: Use empty array. Skip the K-eff plot page with a placeholder text. Log warning.

invalid_data.non_numeric_arrays: Raise TypeError with clear message identifying the offending field.
invalid_data.empty_dataset: Raise ValueError('No data to plot — CNQ JSON contains no trajectory channels').

pdf_generation_failure.matplotlib_error: Catch, log full traceback to JOURNAL.md, fall back to minimal text-only PDF with hashes still embedded.
pdf_generation_failure.missing_temp_file: Raise FileNotFoundError after generation step if expected temp file is absent.

metadata_embedding_failure.pypdf_error: Generate PDF without metadata. Write warning to JOURNAL.md. Still return PDF path so caller can decide whether to keep it.

verapdf_validation_failure.action: Delete the generated PDF. Log full veraPDF report to JOURNAL.md. Raise RuntimeError. The pipeline must not return an unvalidated PDF as if it were archival.

verapdf_unavailable.action: Skip validation step with a logged warning. Return the PDF but mark it as 'unvalidated' in JOURNAL.md. This is a graceful degradation for environments without veraPDF installed.

missing_keys_fallbacks.n_records_T: Extract from bearing array length if available, else 'unknown'

embedding_locations: PDF/A-3 attached files (full JSON inside the PDF itself)
additional_protection: Embed full provenance JSON as /Hs_Provenance_JSON for compact access
Attach full CNT JSON and CNQ JSON as PDF/A-3 file attachments for complete reproducibility
Optional: Add visible QR code on page 1 containing content_sha256 (defer to v2)
Recommended workflow: Publish PDF + source JSON side-by-side with matching hashes

integration_points.cctt_protocol: Call cnq_to_archival_pdf() as the final step of CCTT Phase 7 (Journal with full provenance)
integration_points.cnq_engine: Accept full CNQ JSON output directly; no transformation required
integration_points.callable_from: hs_run.py main pipeline OR standalone CLI

unit_tests: Test with missing optional keys (each separately)
Test with missing critical keys (must raise)
Test with empty arrays for plot data
Test metadata extraction and hash verification
Test veraPDF validation fail case (deliberately broken PDF)
testing_requirements.integration_test: Run full CCTT pipeline on EMBER Germany sample and verify final PDF (a) passes veraPDF, (b) metadata hashes match source JSON, (c) extracted JSON attachment matches source JSON byte-for-byte
testing_requirements.regression_test: Hash of the final PDF must match across two independent runs on same input (determinism check)

open_questions_future_work: Should we embed a visible QR code on page 1 containing the SHA-256? (Defer to v2)
Support for multi-page vector tables (e.g. helmsman flip table per timestep)?
Integration with LaTeX-generated figures for typographic-quality output?
Automatic upload to Zenodo / figshare with DOI + matching hash?
Twin-quaternion-specific report page when twin_quaternion_factoring is present in the input JSON?

implementation_priority.phase_1: Core generation + hash embedding (matches Grok's v2.5)
implementation_priority.phase_2: PDF/A-3 compliance + veraPDF validation + JSON attachment
implementation_priority.phase_3: Structured JOURNAL.md logging + cleanup helper + run_id
implementation_priority.phase_4: QR code + visible provenance block on page 1
implementation_priority.phase_6: LaTeX hybrid rendering for typographic-grade output

claude_instructions.style: Follow existing repo conventions (deterministic, hash-first, well-documented). Match the docstring style of hci_shared/factoring.py and tools/pipeline/hs_audit.py
claude_instructions.error_philosophy: Fail loudly on critical missing hashes. Fail gracefully on optional visualization data. Never return an unvalidated PDF as if it were archival.
claude_instructions.documentation: Add clear docstrings + example usage in every function. Cross-reference INV-062 + this spec file.
claude_instructions.phase_5_constraint: DO NOT IMPLEMENT during the conference window (now through 2026-06-06). This is a specification, not an implementation directive. Implementation work goes in a separate push after the conference.

stop_rules.do_not_modify_engine_code: No changes to cnt.py or cnq.py
stop_rules.must_pass_verapdf_to_be_accepted: Any implementation that returns a PDF that fails veraPDF validation is rejected at code review
stop_rules.must_be_deterministic: Two runs on identical input must produce byte-identical PDFs (within timestamp metadata)

what_this_spec_is_not: Not a substitute for the existing hs_reporter.py (which serves a different role)
Not a replacement for the existing PDF generators (helix, manifold, polar_stack, etc.) — those serve different visualization roles
Not a substitute for the 43-test suite or the IEEE-floor publication gate
Not approved for implementation during the conference window
